scope: One synthetic CPU-only Python workload on the lab's pinned Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind node/containerd: red baseline runs as root with a writable root filesystem and RuntimeDefault; green runs as UID 65534 with readOnlyRootFilesystem, dropped capabilities, no privilege escalation, and a case-owned Localhost seccomp profile that returns EPERM only for uname. The fixture confirms getpid and an emptyDir scratch write remain permitted. Server-dry-run admission samples cover the exact profile and read-only-root guard for regular/init containers on Pod CREATE and ephemeral containers on pods/ephemeralcontainers UPDATE. GPU ioctl, shared GPU memory, RDMA verbs, hardware integration, production profile discovery, and provider/runtime variants are not exercised.
